rounds: How many model rounds (requests to the AI model) a turn ran.
tokens.in: {{tokens}} is a token count the model read (e.g. 1.2k), compact.
tokens.cached: The share of those tokens read from the model's cache (a percentage).
tokens.out: {{tokens}} is a token count the model wrote.
tokens.reasoning: {{tokens}} is a token count the model spent reasoning.
